transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here today because I've been having these episodes where I eat an unusually large amount of food all at once. During these times, I feel this complete loss of control, like I just can't stop myself from eating.
After these episodes of eating, do you engage in any behaviors to try to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, using laxatives, or excessive exercising?
No, I don't do any of those things after I eat. I've never tried to make myself throw up, use laxatives, or exercise excessively to make up for it.
Do you feel significantly distressed, guilty, or ashamed about these eating episodes?
Yes, I feel incredibly guilty and disgusted with myself every single time it happens. It usually leaves me feeling really depressed, and the whole situation causes me a lot of distress.
How often do these binge-eating episodes typically occur, and how long have you been experiencing this pattern of eating?
I've been dealing with this pattern of eating for about two years and five months now. On average, these episodes happen at least once a week.
